6: # Desktop Control Skill
7: 
8: This skill provides comprehensive desktop automation capabilities through PyAutoGUI, allowing AI agents to control the mouse, keyboard, take screenshots, and interact with the desktop environment.
9: 
10: ## How to Use This Skill
11: 
12: As an AI agent, you can invoke desktop automation commands using the `uvx desktop-agent` CLI.
13: 
14: ### Command Structure
15: 
16: All commands follow this pattern:
17: 
18: ```bash
19: uvx desktop-agent <category> <command> [arguments] [options]
20: ```
21: 
22: **Categories:**
23: - `mouse` - Mouse control
24: - `keyboard` - Keyboard input
25: - `screen` - Screenshots and screen analysis
26: - `message` - User dialogs
27: - `app` - Application control (open, focus, list windows)
28: 
29: ## Available Commands
30: 
31: ### 🖱️ Mouse Control (`mouse`)
32: 
33: Control cursor movement and clicks.
34: 
35: ```bash
36: # Move cursor to coordinates
37: uvx desktop-agent mouse move <x> <y> [--duration SECONDS]
38: 
39: # Click at current position or specific coordinates
40: uvx desktop-agent mouse click [x] [y] [--button left|right|middle] [--clicks N]
41: 
42: # Specialized clicks
43: uvx desktop-agent mouse double-click [x] [y]
44: uvx desktop-agent mouse right-click [x] [y]
45: uvx desktop-agent mouse middle-click [x] [y]
46: 
47: # Drag to coordinates
48: uvx desktop-agent mouse drag <x> <y> [--duration SECONDS] [--button BUTTON]
49: 
50: # Scroll (positive=up, negative=down)
51: uvx desktop-agent mouse scroll <clicks> [x] [y]
52: 
53: # Get current mouse position
54: uvx desktop-agent mouse position
55: ```
56: 
57: **Examples:**
58: ```bash
59: # Move to center of 1920x1080 screen
60: uvx desktop-agent mouse move 960 540 --duration 0.5
61: 
62: # Right-click at specific location
63: uvx desktop-agent mouse right-click 500 300
64: 
65: # Scroll down 5 clicks
66: uvx desktop-agent mouse scroll -5
67: ```
68: 
69: ### ⌨️ Keyboard Control (`keyboard`)
70: 
71: Type text and execute keyboard shortcuts.
72: 
73: ```bash
74: # Type text
75: uvx desktop-agent keyboard write "<text>" [--interval SECONDS]
76: 
77: # Press keys
78: uvx desktop-agent keyboard press <key> [--presses N] [--interval SECONDS]
79: 
80: # Execute hotkey combination (comma-separated)
81: uvx desktop-agent keyboard hotkey "<key1>,<key2>,..."
82: 
83: # Hold/release keys
84: uvx desktop-agent keyboard keydown <key>
85: uvx desktop-agent keyboard keyup <key>
86: ```
87: 
88: **Examples:**
89: ```bash
90: # Type text with natural delay
91: uvx desktop-agent keyboard write "Hello World" --interval 0.05
92: 
93: # Copy selected text
94: uvx desktop-agent keyboard hotkey "ctrl,c"
95: 
96: # Open Task Manager
97: uvx desktop-agent keyboard hotkey "ctrl,shift,esc"
98: 
99: # Press Enter 3 times
100: uvx desktop-agent keyboard press enter --presses 3
101: ```
102: 
103: **Common Key Names:**
104: - Modifiers: `ctrl`, `shift`, `alt`, `win`
105: - Special: `enter`, `tab`, `esc`, `space`, `backspace`, `delete`
106: - Function: `f1` through `f12`
107: - Arrows: `up`, `down`, `left`, `right`
108: 
109: ### 🖼️ Screen & Screenshots (`screen`)
110: 
111: Capture screenshots and analyze screen content. Supports targeting specific windows.
112: 
113: ```bash
114: # Take screenshot
115: uvx desktop-agent screen screenshot <filename> [--region "x,y,width,height"] [--window <title>] [--active]
116: 
117: # Locate image on screen or within window
118: uvx desktop-agent screen locate <image_path> [--confidence 0.0-1.0] [--window <title>] [--active]
119: uvx desktop-agent screen locate-center <image_path> [--confidence 0.0-1.0] [--window <title>] [--active]
120: 
121: # Locate text using OCR within window
122: uvx desktop-agent screen locate-text-coordinates <text> [--window <title>] [--active]
123: uvx desktop-agent screen read-all-text [--window <title>] [--active]
124: 
125: # Utility commands
126: uvx desktop-agent screen pixel <x> <y>
127: uvx desktop-agent screen size
128: uvx desktop-agent screen on-screen <x> <y>
129: ```
130: 
131: **Examples:**
132: ```bash
133: # Screenshot of active window
134: uvx desktop-agent screen screenshot active.png --active
135: 
136: # Screenshot of a specific application
137: uvx desktop-agent screen screenshot chrome.png --window "Google Chrome"
138: 
139: # Locate image within Notepad
140: uvx desktop-agent screen locate-center button.png --window "Notepad"
141: ```
142: 
143: ### 💬 Message Dialogs (`message`)
144: 
145: Display user interaction dialogs.
146: 
147: ```bash
148: # Show alert
149: uvx desktop-agent message alert "<text>" [--title TITLE] [--button BUTTON]
150: 
151: # Show confirmation dialog
152: uvx desktop-agent message confirm "<text>" [--title TITLE] [--buttons "OK,Cancel"]
153: 
154: # Prompt for input
155: uvx desktop-agent message prompt "<text>" [--title TITLE] [--default TEXT]
156: 
157: # Password input
158: uvx desktop-agent message password "<text>" [--title TITLE] [--mask CHAR]
159: ```
160: 
161: **Examples:**
162: ```bash
163: # Simple alert
164: uvx desktop-agent message alert "Task completed!"
165: 
166: # Get user confirmation
167: uvx desktop-agent message confirm "Continue with operation?"
168: 
169: # Ask for user input
170: uvx desktop-agent message prompt "Enter your name:"
171: ```
172: 
173: ### 📱 Application Control (`app`)
174: 
175: Control applications across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
176: 
177: ```bash
178: # Open an application by name
179: uvx desktop-agent app open <name> [--arg ARGS...]
180: 
181: # Focus on a window by title/name
182: uvx desktop-agent app focus <name>
183: 
184: # List all visible windows
185: uvx desktop-agent app list
186: ```
187: 
188: **Examples:**
189: ```bash
190: # Windows: Open Notepad
191: uvx desktop-agent app open notepad
192: 
193: # Windows: Open Chrome with a URL
194: uvx desktop-agent app open "chrome" --arg "https://google.com"
195: 
196: # macOS: Open Safari
197: uvx desktop-agent app open "Safari"
198: 
199: # Focus on a specific window
200: uvx desktop-agent app focus "Untitled - Notepad"
201: 
202: # List all open windows
203: uvx desktop-agent app list
204: ```

207:

209:

269: ## Safety Considerations
270: 
271: When using this skill, AI agents should:
272: 
273: 1. **Verify coordinates**: Use `screen size` and `on-screen` before clicking
274: 2. **Add delays**: Insert appropriate delays between commands for UI responsiveness
275: 3. **Validate images**: Ensure image files exist before using `locate` commands
276: 4. **Handle failures**: Commands may fail if windows change or elements move
277: 5. **User safety**: Always confirm destructive actions with user via `message confirm`
278: 
279: ## Troubleshooting
280: 
281: ### PyAutoGUI Fail-Safe
282: PyAutoGUI has a fail-safe: moving mouse to screen corner aborts operations. This is a safety feature.
283: 
284: ### Image not found
285: When using `screen locate`, ensure:
286: - Image file exists and path is correct
287: - Adjust `--confidence` (try 0.7-0.9)
288: - Image matches exact screen appearance (resolution, colors)
289:

291: 
292: ```bash
293: # Show all available commands
294: uvx desktop-agent --help
295: 
296: # Show commands for specific category
297: uvx desktop-agent mouse --help
298: uvx desktop-agent keyboard --help
299: uvx desktop-agent screen --help
300: uvx desktop-agent message --help
301: 
302: # Show help for specific command
303: uvx desktop-agent mouse move --help
304: ```

306: ## Integration Tips for AI Agents
307: 
308: 1. **Always check screen size first** when working with absolute coordinates
309: 2. **Use relative positioning** when possible (e.g., get current position, calculate offset)
310: 3. **Combine commands** for complex workflows
311: 4. **Validate before executing** (e.g., check if image exists on screen)
312: 5. **Provide user feedback** using message dialogs for important operations
313: 6. **Handle errors gracefully** - commands may fail if UI state changes
314: 
315: ## Performance Notes
316: 
317: - Mouse movements with `--duration` are animated and take time
318: - Image location (`locate`) can be slow on large screens - use regions when possible
319: - Keyboard commands are generally fast (< 100ms)
320: - Screenshots depend on screen resolution and region size
